company.name: Fond
company.shortDescription: Fond is a SaaS platform that makes it easy to use and manage employee rewards and recognition programs.
company.description:
Fond is a SaaS platform that seamlessly consolidates employee rewards and recognition processes into one easy-to-use solution. With Fond, employees and managers can recognize each other, redeem rewards, access exclusive corporate discounts, and measure success so HR departments spend less time managing programs and more time driving results.

Fond is headquartered in San Francisco, California. Learn more at https://www.fond.co.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $11,500,000, or 44.49% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,607,701 to $73,181,273, a 11.08x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Elemeno Health, Bonusly, Achievers.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
